blocks.text: Investigating the Effects of Physical Activity on Breathing

blocks.md:
- Exercise increases the **frequency and depth of breathing**
- This can be investigated in various ways, for example **counting the breaths taken during one minute at rest** and **measuring average chest expansion over 5 breaths** using a tape measure held around the chest
- Exercise (such a star jumps/jogging on the spot) for a set time period (at least 3 minutes)
- Immediately after exercising, **count the breaths taken in one minute **and** measure the average chest expansion over 5 breaths**
- Following exercise, the **number of breaths per minute will increase** and the **chest expansion will also increase**
